

```{r}
# Get from reference genome the nucleotide&amino acids sequences of gene BA3367

library(Biostrings)
genome_seq <- readDNAStringSet("../data/reference_to_screen/AE016879.fasta")
target_chromosome_name <- "AE016879.1 Bacillus anthracis str. Ames, complete genome"
start_position <- 3097033
end_position <- 3098820
target_sequence <- genome_seq[names(genome_seq) == target_chromosome_name]
section_seq <- subseq(target_sequence, start=start_position, end=end_position)
writeXStringSet(section_seq, "../data/reference_to_screen/BA_3367_AE016879.fasta")

reverse_complement_dna <- reverseComplement(section_seq)
amino_acid_sequence <- Biostrings::translate(reverse_complement_dna)

aa_set_to_save <- AAStringSet(amino_acid_sequence)
names(aa_set_to_save) <- paste0("BA3367_AA")

writeXStringSet(aa_set_to_save, 
              filepath = paste0("../data/reference_to_screen/BA3367_AA.fasta"), 
              format = "fasta")
```


```{r}
# from annotatd mappings on CTMA sample retreive a correct genome version of each sample

files <- sub("\\.vcf(?:\\.gz)?$", "", list.files(path = "../data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage",
                    pattern = "^CTMA_.*\\.vcf(?:\\.gz)?$",
                    full.names = FALSE))

ref <- paste0("data/reference_to_screen/AE016879.fasta")
for (file in files){
  vcf <- paste0("data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/",file,".vcf")
  consensus <- paste0("data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/",file,".fasta")
  
  myarg <- paste0('run --rm -v ./../:/data --cpus=2 staphb/bcftools:1.21 sh -c "bcftools view /data/',vcf,' -Oz -o /data/',vcf,'.gz','"')
  system2("docker", args = myarg)
  myarg <- paste0('run --rm -v ./../:/data --cpus=2 staphb/bcftools:1.21 sh -c "bcftools index /data/',vcf,'.gz','"')
  system2(command='docker',args=myarg)
  myarg <-  paste0('run --rm -v ./../:/data --cpus=2 staphb/bcftools:1.21 sh -c "cat /data/',ref,' | bcftools consensus /data/',vcf,'.gz > /data/',consensus,'"')
  system2("docker", args = myarg)
}
```

```{r}
# From the corrected sample genomes extract the part linked to the BA3367 gene for future AlphaFold modelling

BA3367 <- readDNAStringSet("../data/reference_to_screen/BA_3367_AE016879.fasta")

for (file in files){
  CTMA_X <- readDNAStringSet(paste0("../data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/",file,".fasta"))
  
  shortened_CTMA_X <- CTMA_X[[1]][3090000:3150000]
  
  alignment <- pairwiseAlignment(shortened_CTMA_X, BA3367, type="local")
  start_long <- start(pattern(alignment))
  end_long <- end(pattern(alignment))
  trimmed_CTMA_X <- shortened_CTMA_X[start_long:end_long]
  
  reverse_complement_dna <- reverseComplement(trimmed_CTMA_X)
  amino_acid_sequence <- Biostrings::translate(reverse_complement_dna)
  aa_set_to_save <- AAStringSet(amino_acid_sequence)
  names(aa_set_to_save) <- paste0(file, "_BA3367_AA")
  
  writeXStringSet(aa_set_to_save, 
                filepath = paste0("../data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/", file, "_BA3367_AA.fasta"), 
                format = "fasta")s

}
```

```{r}
# Combine sequences for read allignment comparison

files <- list.files("../data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/", pattern="\\_BA3367_AA_subset_region_2.fasta$", ignore.case=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)
out <- file("../data/data_proc/06a_freebayes_gamma_phage/combined_BA3367_AA_subset_region_2.fasta.fasta", "w")
for(f in files) {
  name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  for(line in readLines(f)) {
    if (substr(line,1,1) == ">") writeLines(paste0(">", name, "|", substring(line,2)), out) else writeLines(line, out)
  }
}
close(out)

```
